draft.weaknessQuote: Needs to pair his feet with his hands in run game.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.49, the 11th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 1st of 16 at TE. He lasted until pick 42, well after his grade rank (11th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Dallas Goedert. Testing standouts: 10-yard split (94th percentile), broad jump (81st percentile). College production: 169 receiving yards in 2022, 15th of 16 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Green Bay Packers (physically unable to perform). 35 career games and 22 starts over 3 completed seasons. Producing near his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: catch rate 77.4% (84th percentile). Weak spots: receiving td 0 (15th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 tight end who played: 252 receiving yards against a median of 196, above the norm.
